title: Assess source fitness for complete Argentina seven-component gap family
body:
# Argentina complete-family source-fitness evidence

This packet assesses exactly the seven-member family `gap-source-batch:af41d8136269b78548021a84` for issue [#1418](https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/issues/1418), linked to the still-open parent [#1202](https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/issues/1202). It preserves all seven physical components, four current contacts, three positive-length neighbors, all six administrative source-feature observations referenced by the component rows, the one recorded land-source-fitness row, and the original emitted source-relative rows and numeric values. The complete rows are in the two `source-fit.json` results and the compact family/component files beside them.

## Scope and current evidence

The frozen routing report records seven components in source-family order with roster SHA-256 `b2b8155d09bfa4e86a51b8ed6617927790e9c666c9294f96fcc9a7453b87dbda`. The four current contacts are Castelli (`gb:ARG:ADM2:61730980B13025573352502`), Villarino (`gb:ARG:ADM2:61730980B44606052944654`), Magdalena (`gb:ARG:ADM2:61730980B51096129050346`), and Pinamar (`gb:ARG:ADM2:61730980B99310691740446`). Positive-length neighbors are Castelli, Villarino, and Pinamar; Magdalena is a contact but not one of the recorded positive-length neighbors. The emitted family record does not provide a numeric boundary length.

The source rows reference six 2020 geoBoundaries feature IDs: Castelli, Patagones, Villarino, Magdalena, General Juan Madariaga, and Pinamar. The component rows, including each recorded feature intersection, source hash, original measurement, and identity binding, are preserved without rerunning the global physical producer. Their status mix is three `mapped-land-support`, one `mixed-source-support`, one `outside-mapped-L1-context`, and two `unknown`; two members remain in numeric closure. The family’s exact next-prerequisite counts are preserved in the full family row. These are prior source-relative classifications, not new geometric measurements or proof of land surface.

## Source identity, terms, and limits

The authenticated consumed product is the simplified geoBoundaries ARG ADM2 GeoJSON. The baseline `data/location-policy.json` is pinned alongside `scripts/administrative.py`; the policy’s Argentina URL, the recipe’s `_simplified.geojson` transform, and the pinned [original-source catalogue](../../../coordination/engineering/original-geography-source-corpus-20261006/catalogue.json) resolve to the same simplified product URL. The raw decoded payload is 5,502,879 bytes, SHA-256 `cedee8710e49d9017327fc1d4b2dc536e95a82317dc94c3bac8d9404af6bf771`, CRS84 (longitude/latitude), and 525 features. The catalogue’s advertised count and retained product metadata say 526. All six source feature IDs present in the physical component rows resolve in the consumed product. The four current contacts match by exact `shapeID` and `shapeName`; the simplified features have null `shapeParent`, while the Atlas contact records currently carry the Buenos Aires parent. This is an identity/context reconciliation, not a boundary comparison.

The retained geoBoundaries product metadata records boundary year 2020, departments, underlying sources Instituto Geográfico Nacional and UNHCR/OCHA ROLAC, CC BY 3.0 IGO, source data update date 2023-01-19, and build date 2023-12-12. The product-level retrieval timestamp is not recorded; the `original-geography-source-corpus-20261006` path identifies its collection campaign only. The source registry and frozen routing row record an **unsimplified** locator, while the catalogue and consumed bytes identify the **simplified** product. These locators and bytes are not equated. The report retains both records.

The metadata states CC BY 3.0 IGO. The [official license deed](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/igo/deed.en) describes attribution, a license link, and no implied endorsement; that record does not resolve upstream permissions beyond the product metadata or establish political authority, legal boundaries, currentness, dry land, ownership, source lineage, or completeness.

The 2026-10-07 issue-contract amendment replaces the oversized archive as an ordinary evidence input with two existing whole-file metadata pins: source identity register SHA-256 `08891ff552e397d237e63feaaea4a4ae4cad69d1d947ca74fd86b13157369347` and packet manifest SHA-256 `c426aa785e4282bd7c4653a3e72c6f64201afb8736675242b3c59d8ead659534`. The #443 register and transport manifest cross-bind the encoded archive identity to the #442 inventory’s 69,702,323-byte decoded identity. The archive itself is not read or decompressed by this packet. [`issue-contract-before-amendment.json`](issue-contract-before-amendment.json) preserves the entire preceding issue body, including its earlier archive pin and all previous criteria; [`issue-contract-after-amendment.json`](issue-contract-after-amendment.json) records the independent issue body readback and SHA-256.

The six geoBoundaries names have exact-name matches in the pinned Georef comparator for Buenos Aires (Castelli, Patagones, Villarino, Magdalena, General Juan Madariaga, and Pinamar). The comparison includes only IDs/names/province labels from the Georef records. It does not compare or redistribute Georef geometry. Its layer vintage and reuse terms remain unconfirmed in the pinned #960 packet, so this is not an independent authority or legal-boundary finding.

Completed #442 remains the source for the prior unsimplified product record: its pinned inventory records 69,702,323 decoded bytes and SHA-256 `f35dae5a257302dea5bd1549ae135baf82e7ee7491918854c3db9bbdec890177`, 525 observed features versus 526 advertised, plus a recorded registry/source hash discrepancy. The pinned #443 source register and packet manifest cross-bind the encoded archive identity (22,949,678 bytes; SHA-256 `aaf34413713c3b75175d04b6b7cafa4910ebdca762d2637a6547024466e3e07e`) to that decoded identity. This packet does not read or decompress the oversized archive: decoded admission is refused before read because the recorded size exceeds the 32 MiB evidence input cap, and no geometry from it is admitted. Contact reuse in #442 does not establish physical-family overlap. The earlier broad exclusion comment on #1202 is preserved unchanged; the subsequent correction records the distinct family-level reconciliation.

No source-fitness, physical-authority, cause, effective-date, lineage, land-water, physical-completeness, boundary-length, or legal-ownership approval is made. No geography or record is changed, no geometry is repaired or imported, and nothing is clipped, snapped, simplified, filled, released, or published.

## Reproduction and controls

Reproduce the final pair from a clean checkout with CPython 3.12.14 and the exact immutable helper pinned by issue #1418:

```sh
/Users/chengshuli/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/python/bin/python3 research/geography/argentina-gap-source-fitness-20261007/run_pair.py
/Users/chengshuli/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/bin/node scripts/evidence-quality.mjs research/geography/argentina-gap-source-fitness-20261007/evidence-quality.json
```

The pair runner assigns unique timestamped run and receipt vintages on every invocation, so it can be rerun from the submitted checkout without overwriting retained evidence. It records actual commands, UTC start/end times, exit codes, stdout/stderr hashes, runtime, executed runner/helper hashes, and output hashes, then publishes the run log and byte-equality receipt through `NewVintage`. Each extraction reads only issue-pinned whole files through `Baseline`, applies the helper’s 32 MiB per-file and 256 MiB phase caps, and writes through `NewVintage`. The exact pinned helper bytes are compiled and executed from `git show`; the materialized checkout copy is not imported. The runner uses Python’s standard JSON/gzip libraries; no GIS library or global graph rebuild is used. Each fresh run checks all seven family members, all four current contacts, all six referenced administrative feature IDs, the one source-fitness row, all three neighbors, and the complete retained component source rows. A changed component ID in the full compressed family slice is rejected by the same input reader at the whole-file SHA check before output admission. The two fresh `source-fit.json` files are recorded with equal byte hashes in the execution receipt. The exact issue contract preceding the 2026-10-07 pin amendment and its independent post-amendment readback are preserved in `issue-contract-before-amendment.json` and `issue-contract-after-amendment.json`.

`evidence-quality.json` is the byte manifest for this packet. Its `limited` result is intentional: retrieval timestamp, unsimplified decoded input, Georef vintage/terms, source authority, physical cause and surface status remain unresolved. It is evidence review, not geographic approval or a publication gate.

Closes #1418

body:
First independently demonstrated 2026-10-08 America/Los_Angeles by Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`; earlier occurrence unknown. Quality parent #726. Affected [PR #1419](https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/pull/1419), exact merge `48dc38505580eee58f11040574a4de832015641e`, final head `e9820d03b43b2bf061b3cc128d9c2bbddc858f7d`. Preserve closed #1418, parent #1202, the complete original packet and all earlier vintages. This finding concerns the standalone final verification writer, not evidence that the original source assessment is incorrect.

## Demonstrated false-success receipt

In the unchanged final `reproduce.py`, `--finalize-reproducibility` reads two complete `source-fit.json` files and checks their byte equality. For the process receipt it checks only `outcome == "passed"` and that there are two entries. It does not validate either entry's `exit_code`, bind each distinct run to the requested run/output, or validate the recorded command/runtime/code/stream/output bindings before publishing `reproducibility.json` marked passed and a complete `publication.json`.

The Auditor first ran the actual unchanged `run_pair.py` in an admitted, credential-free, exact-merge managed review slot. Two genuine extraction subprocesses exited zero. Both full 111489-byte source-fit reports have SHA-256 `9815926220c835c03524f516d1fc2a832010f6db45a9c0c6659065084ce5a1f6`, equal to the latest retained pair. Their source/identity reconciliation independently matched all seven component rows, four complete current contacts, three neighbors, six source identities, all525 consumed simplified features and six exact-name/province Georef matches. All22 whole reference inputs were independently authenticated; the oversized archive was not read or decoded.

Starting from that authentic complete fresh process receipt, the Auditor changed only the two process `exit_code` values to **19 and23**, leaving the top-level outcome and all other recorded fields unchanged. The actual unchanged finalizer exited zero, published `reproducibility.json` with `outcome:"passed"`, retained those nonzero exits in `execution-receipt.json`, and wrote a complete publication receipt. This directly contradicts its stated requirement for two successful recorded extraction processes. In a second actual invocation, supplying the same successful run name for both `--run-one` and `--run-two` also exited zero and published completion, despite the receipt still describing two different original runs. A file compared with itself is not a distinct two-run replay.

Both existing ordinary and dangling-symlink destinations correctly refused and preserved their owned sentinels/literal links. The separate main producer's output boundaries and unequal-report refusal are verified in the original PR's audit. The trusted full manifest validator returned limited with35 changed files and56 descriptors; it does not independently establish the finalizer's process/run binding. The genuine original replay was successful; these negative controls demonstrate an acceptance gap rather than claiming that its historical positive receipt was fabricated.

## Safe bounded reproduction

Inspect the exact merged code first. Use an admitted isolated exact-merge review slot with the original22 input inventory and private credential-free HOME/TMP. Run unchanged `run_pair.py` once to obtain two genuine fresh runs and its complete execution receipt. Preserve all originals and write a new receipt fixture in owned scratch. Set its two `processes[*].exit_code` values to19 and23, leaving every other field intact. Invoke the actual finalizer with that fixture, the two actual fresh run names, and a previously absent check vintage:

```text
python3 -B research/geography/argentina-gap-source-fitness-20261007/reproduce.py --finalize-reproducibility --execution-log YOUR_OWNED_FAILED_EXIT_RECEIPT.json --run-one ACTUAL_FRESH_RUN_A --run-two ACTUAL_FRESH_RUN_B --check-vintage argentina-repro-check-YOUR_FRESH_CHECK
```

Observed: exit0 and passed completion containing failed extraction exits. A second fresh invocation using ACTUAL_FRESH_RUN_A for both run parameters is also accepted. Account for the whole encoded+decoded input union, code/runtime, complete fixtures and outputs before execution; do not reset a budget within one operation. No source acquisition or geographic producer rerun is required.

## One additive engineering PR

Depend on closed #1418. Own only `coordination/engineering/argentina-repro-receipt-1419/`; maximum **one PR**. Implement an additive bounded verification/finalization successor and its owned manifest/usage. Do not edit or regenerate any original research packet, source, dated attempt or shared helper. The exact four subject IDs and complete seven-component roster remain required immutable scope, not authority to change their geography.

Require zero exits; require unambiguous one-to-one requested run/process/output correspondence. body:
Raised and independently demonstrated 2026-10-09 (America/Los_Angeles), post-merge Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`. Quality parent #726; affected PR #1484, exact merge `6c0ea95b7a8214ac1548161368bd952af136b5c2`, head `ae5920a92ed946930f01e3737983713dd46cb92b`. Original #928 remains open with its one-PR allowance exhausted and documented source waits. This is a bounded correction of an independently demonstrated factual evidence defect, not another attempt to restore the entire icefield or approve geography.

The packet's `source-inventory.json` and `evidence-quality.json` call the cited/restorable agreement a **1998** instrument; `findings.md` attributes the enumerated-vertices/annexed-charts account to1998. The exact recorded PDF is actually the **2 August1991** agreement. Its sixth/final page visibly states1991, with Di Tella and Silva Cimma signatures. Full restored original:191,319 bytes, SHA256 `c29a05138447ea20153b95be7c267618ed05edd85c334275efd70dbac8ae2239`, exactly the packet's original pin. No downloaded-byte drift explains the discrepancy.

[Official instrument1796 record](https://tratados.cancilleria.gob.ar/tratado_ficha.php?id=kqSrmw%3D%3D) independently identifies the same agreement as signed02/08/1991, marks it not in force, and directs readers to the16 December1998 agreement. Audit retrieval:14,594 bytes/SHA256 `d5871d0d94b7d32c18a2f6fefed2e4241742d42173267bd1c43bfa234648a489`. The restored1996 protocol is correctly dated10 December1996 but repeatedly refers to the1991 agreement, including conditional ratification/demarcation wording; it does not authenticate the1998 agreement. Full original213,548 bytes/SHA256 `cfab3e2e9e8cc7b4d2ae2949bcf4f5112fc471fda444c7b7600c9773f69afa71`, exact pin. [Official protocol1852 record](https://tratados.cancilleria.gob.ar/tratado_ficha.php?id=kqWnlw%3D%3D) corroborates its date and records the returned legislative message; avoid inventing entry-into-force conclusions from signature alone.

The separate [official Law25.110 and1998 agreement text](https://www.argentina.gob.ar/normativa/nacional/ley-25110-58471/texto) states16 December1998 and divides the instrument into SectionsA/B. Audit retrieval45,101 bytes/SHA256 `20a67f6bc8c8a7c8d0b1aff96d36eb75b6c08ea9439be91fcf4f51c17d369d5c`. It supports instrument identity/date and why the older PDF cannot be substituted; this audit did not restore/georeference all1998 chart annexes or establish current demarcation.

Reproduce read-only: restore the packet's exact alleged1998 PDF URL and verify the whole hash/size above; inspect all relevant pages, especially signature page6; compare the official instrument1796 record and the actual1998 text. For the protocol inspect its full five pages, opening1991-reference and final1996 date. Preserve all original source bytes. The original packet's two actual unchanged reproduction runs pass19 checks/four identity controls and yield originalSHA256 `34ebfbf1ebce8b55314d16614aefbeb221a54891b47b5f710469a438359d6b40`; fresh trusted current-main gate returns `limited`, authenticates16 files/all12changes/two metrics and exact-head review binding. Neither checks actual treaty date/source identity, so those passes do not validate the incorrect1998 attribution.

Success criteria, one additive geography PR under the new namespace only:

1. Publish a sourced erratum mapping each1991/1996/1998 instrument to its actual title/date/official identifier, correct whole source URL/hash/size and restoration/reuse limits. Identify all affected original findings/manifest source and conclusion references; preserve the old packet as dated history rather than rewriting original evidence.
2. Restore a genuine dated1998 primary agreement record/text and inspect its relevant sections and annex completeness. Distinguish1991 proposed route,1996 protocol context,1998 agreement,2018 government statements and unknown current status. If complete1998 annex restoration is unavailable, state the exact missing scope; do not reuse an older agreement as a substitute.
3. Derive positive and adverse source-identity/date checks from complete primary records. A correctly hashed1991 PDF labeled1998, or a coherently rehashed substituted instrument, must not pass as the1998 source. Use actual correction entry points and whole-file pins; keep unknown legal status/annex/current-demarcation claims explicit.
4. Keep exact subject `country-SPI`, all five original issue-baseline pins and the three affected packet descriptors below. Preserve feature/geometry/stable ID/parent and original928's1PR budget, ownership and source waits. No ice-field shape download/correction, legal coordinate polygon, sovereignty assignment, migration, integration, geographic approval or publication. Capture actual code/runtime/check results, complete data/code/control/output admission, two fresh reproducible outputs, distinct exact-head source review and normal serialized merge.

Deduplication: complete1613 all-state entries over17 pages exhausted; #928 is the exhausted broader source restoration/role task, #937/#938 are different regional rosters, closed #1111/#1122 are different crosswalk/provenance binding repairs. No later main commit changes the1484 packet. This specific wrong-instrument attribution has no existing repair owner. New disjoint path preserves existing source/worker scopes. Initially blocked pending fresh shared read-only readiness, dependencies/open-PR/ownership review; urgent/follow-up does not confer geographic authority. No dependency on928 closure: the input packet is already merged and this narrow evidence defect can be corrected independently.

body:
Parent: #443; unblocked 2026-10-05 (America/Los_Angeles) after PR #947 merged and the serialized claim release was confirmed.

The complete Atlas area “Argentina Northwest” owns 162 ADM2 locations spread over nine provinces: Catamarca, Jujuy, La Rioja, Salta, Santiago del Estero, Tucumán, Mendoza, San Juan and San Luis. Current official sources are not uniform by purpose: COFEMA groups the first five as NOA and the last four as Cuyo; a 2024 viticulture report and 2026 event material use different NOA member lists. No one framework is asserted here as a universal boundary.

Acceptance:
- Verify the exact 162 area assignments against the pinned scope and identify any source-provided meaning for the area code; do not infer meaning from AGW.
- Compare relevant current official regional definitions by purpose/vintage and recommend whether the Atlas label denotes a documented custom reporting group or needs an engineering rename/repartition.
- Preserve all area/member IDs and release pins; provide a sourced handoff under the owned path, no shared geography changes.
- Do not treat this issue as authorization to publish or certify Southern South America. Coordinate separately with the Argentina Northeast integration owner (#442) if cross-area parents are implicated.

Source lead: [official COFEMA regions](https://www.argentina.gob.ar/jefatura/turismo-y-ambiente/ambiente/articulacion-ambiental/regiones); other dated official uses and source hashes are linked by parent #443.

body:
Closes #443

Completes the bounded, source-only evidence packet for all 215 exact scoped IDs and 14 province parents. The packet retains dated source bytes and restoration/hash instructions, reproduces the source crosswalk, records individual dispositions, and creates linked follow-ups for the unresolved CABA aggregate, La Rioja label, Northwest purpose and ADM1/ADM2 source gaps.

Key limits: exact 2020 source ID/name agreement does not establish current legal boundaries, topology or countrywide completeness. The retained source reports 525 ADM2 features against metadata 526 and its shared register hash differs. The 2006 ADM1 source has a separate 23-vs-current-24 jurisdiction/name discrepancy and a shared register hash mismatch. The CABA city polygon differs from its pinned Natural Earth feature and its 17 replacement members include two Buenos Aires Province districts. Northwest's nine-province membership crosses policy-specific NOA/Cuyo definitions. These remain explicit engineering/source follow-ups; no geography, release or import is approved.

Reproduce from repository root with `python3 data/regional-review/regional-review-7cf674a63057d43f/reproduce.py`. Packet manifest: `data/regional-review/regional-review-7cf674a63057d43f/packet-manifest.json` (SHA-256 `c426aa785e4282bd7c4653a3e72c6f64201afb8736675242b3c59d8ead659534`).

## Independent source and geography review — changes requested

Reviewed PR #950 at exact head `e2cf46d266d13e1713d9381ea19378c7b2d40638`, against #442’s full acceptance and exact 241-ID scope.

**Material finding:** the packet’s WGSRPD AGE roster is factually wrong. The authoritative second-edition table at TDWG commit `52da7828aba9d461dd133c27b3bd7a4407161f54` lists nine L4 units under AGE (Buenos Aires, Chaco, Corrientes, Córdoba, Argentina Distrito Federal, Entre Ríos, Formosa, La Pampa, Misiones). Santa Fe is `AGS-SF`, under AGS / Argentina South. This contradicts the Santa Fe inclusion and count of 10 in `RESEARCH.md`, `province-review.json` (`standard_level4_count` and the area integration roster), and the resulting parent-integration comparison. Please correct every repeated claim and preserve the resulting cross-area membership question for integration. The source inventory points to the explanatory `SecondEdGeog.htm`, not the exact membership tables; retain exact table URLs, vintage and hashes.

Primary table evidence, retrieved 2026-10-05:
- [TDWG tblLevel3.txt](https://github.com/tdwg/wgsrpd/blob/52da7828aba9d461dd133c27b3bd7a4407161f54/109-488-1-ED/2nd%20Edition/tblLevel3.txt), SHA-256 `7eaf281dfbdca610c93938326c333d7c62d8e82ce3cba63b299d5a3a01d0003f`

I independently reran `compare_argentina.py` from the retained private source captures: the 241-row JSONL and summary regenerated byte-for-byte. All eight entries in `artifact-checksums.json` matched. The mismatch is semantic and is not detected by that comparator.

title: Add licensed Georef crosswalk for Argentina Northeast
body:
Adds the licensed Georef v2 source snapshot and reproducible crosswalk for the exact 241 scoped Argentina Northeast IDs. The supplement preserves the prior row classifications, records the service's CC BY 4.0 attribution and unstated data vintage, and corrects the Rivadavia code interpretation with an explicit unresolved source handoff. No shared geography or release data changes; regional certification and imports remain out of scope.

Closes #442
